# Included Sohjae runtime

Source: https://github.com/mson0129/sohjae

Revision: `6f870f8b6dcd58200961743e782c6dc0aebdbfb7`.

These files are copied unchanged from the upstream `web/` directory under MIT.
`manifest.json` records SHA-256 for every included runtime file. Suhjae's build
checks these hashes; update the manifest deliberately when updating the SDK.
This repository owns the application, not a separate fork of the editor core.
